note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content of both items you referenced.

Please provide:
1) The transcript text (doctor-patient conversation) in the exact format you used, or paste the content here.
2) The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format or as a list, exactly as provided.

Once I have those, I will produce a concise, professional SOAP note with:
- Subjective: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, medications, allergies, social history.
- Objective: relevant exam findings and any investigations mentioned.
- Assessment & Plan: structured by issue (1–N) with:
  - Likely diagnosis (name only)
  - DDx items consistent with the transcript (with conflict noted if applicable)
  - Investigations, treatments, and referrals as described or implied by the transcript/DDx
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, internal conflicts (mark “conflict noted”), and any transcript quality concerns.

Notes:
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- I will not invent data beyond what is in the transcript or DDx.
- I will use American English and bullet-point formatting as requested.

Please paste the transcript and DDx exactly as placeholders:
Transcript: <<< {transcript} >>>
DDx: <<< {ddx} >>>
